prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: RGBA paper-theatre component atlas for Pokémon Emerald Shoal Cave at high and low tide. ONE landscape 1536x1024 image, exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows of separately isolated components. Generous transparent gutters, nothing crossing cells, no words/grid/backing sheet. Medium: richly detailed thin hand-cut illustrated cardstock, overlapping flat paper shapes, off-white cut edges, printed small cracks, paper fibers and tiny shell details. Not chunky low-poly 3D, not photorealistic rock, no complete cave backdrop. Front view with slight top view only for low ground components. Palette blue-gray coastal limestone, ivory salt, muted teal seaweed, blue/aqua water, sandy ochre.
Row 1 left to right:
1. Tall narrow asymmetrical limestone cave flank opening toward the right, composed of many overlapping scalloped thin blue-gray paper sheets, tiny barnacle rings and tide marks along base. No broad flat backing.
2. A different tall narrow cave flank opening toward the left, with small ivory salt crust and inset shell details, stepped organic silhouette, not an arch.
3. Low wide distant reef-rock ridge, layered scalloped blue-gray strips with visible gaps in its upper silhouette, detailed salt speckles. No sky or water.
4. THREE separate slim irregular hanging salt stalactites, well separated horizontally, gray paper centers and chalk-white crust edges, no joining bar.
Row 2:
1. Elegant clump of five separate thin teal paper kelp fronds, some curling, tiny ivory shells at their base, no backdrop.
2. Low dense salt-crystal and shell deposit: tiny white geometric paper flakes, scallop shells and an exposed spiral fossil, no water.
3. Wide low tide-water ribbon: several distinct overlapping gently scalloped paper strips in translucent-looking aquamarine, turquoise and deep teal, fine ivory ripples. Organic perimeter, no rectangular cut edges, no rocks, no shadow behind.
4. One narrow VERTICAL trickling seawater ribbon made from several slim blue and ivory paper strips; free irregular edges, no rocks, no floor, no background.
Row 3:
1. Low flat-topped coastal rock ledge, five thin stacked irregular paper slabs with a clear dry ivory top surface and small barnacles along its side, no water.
2. Compact low blue-gray rocky outcrop composed of many layered paper silhouettes with shell fragments and salt crust, no water.
3. A tiny detailed HERMIT CRAB cutout in side view, orange paper legs, cream spiral shell, craft paper edges, entire creature isolated, no ground or shadow.
4. THREE separate small blue paper water droplets vertically spaced in the left half; THREE separate tiny ivory angular paper salt flakes vertically spaced in the right half. Empty space between all six.
Avoid repeating the same outline across different cells. All elements fully contained. Truly transparent background. No ball, people, Pokemon, whole scene, environment floor, labels, text, global cast shadows, or baked checkerboard.
